handoff.salientSummary: Implemented configuration loading (config.ts), AGENTS.md hierarchical discovery (agents-md.ts), and git utility wrappers (git.ts). All 61 tests pass with proper type safety. Config validates model format and thinking levels with sensible defaults when file absent.
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
src/config/config.ts - loads .pi-missions/config.json with defaultModel, defaultThinkingLevel, and missionDir fields. Validates model strings in 'provider:model' format and thinking levels (none/low/intermediate/high). Returns sensible defaults when config absent.

src/config/agents-md.ts - discovers AGENTS.md files hierarchically (project root, .pi-missions/, home directory). Returns files in order with content concatenation and source headers.

src/utils/git.ts - gitInit, gitCommit, gitStatus, gitDiff, isGitRepo wrappers around shell commands. gitStatus parses porcelain output correctly including leading space handling.

src/config/index.ts and src/utils/index.ts - barrel exports.

tests/config.test.ts - 12 tests covering config loading, defaults, validation, error messages.
tests/agents-md.test.ts - 13 tests covering hierarchical discovery, ordering, concatenation.
tests/git.test.ts - 18 tests covering git operations with proper test isolation.
